title: Marketing Executive / Telecaller & Admin Assistant
description:
Job Title: Marketing Executive / Telecaller & Admin Assistant 
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Industry: Plastic & Packaging Industry
 Job Description 
We are looking for a confident, polite, and well-organized Female Marketing Executive / Telecaller who can handle customer communication, face-to-face interactions, and daily administrative office work. The candidate should have good communication skills, basic computer knowledge, and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Telecalling & Customer Handling/ Administrative & Office Work 
 Handle inbound and outbound customer calls. Attend and assist customers visiting the office. Explain company products and services. Follow up on customer enquiries and potential leads. Maintain good relationships with existing and new customers. Coordinate with marketing and sales teams. Handle daily administrative and office-related activities. Maintain customer records, files, and documentation. Prepare quotations, reports, and basic office documents. Perform data entry and update records using computer systems. Handle emails, WhatsApp enquiries, and basic correspondence. Assist management with daily office coordination. Eligibility Criteria 
 Gender: Female candidates only. Marital Status: Married candidates preferred. Experience: Freshers and experienced candidates can apply. Languages: Hindi, English, and Marathi. Communication: Good verbal and written communication skills. Computer Knowledge: Basic knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, and internet. Personal Skills: Confident, polite, responsible, organized, and able to multitask. Vehicle: Must have own vehicle. Salary & Benefits 
 Salary: 13,000 18,000 per month. Salary will depend on experience, skills, and suitability.

title: Junior Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Junior Marketing Executive
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Industry: Plastic & Packaging Industry Flexible Packaging & Woven Sacks 
Job Description
We are looking for motivated and enthusiastic Junior Marketing Executives to support marketing activities, promote company products, generate new leads, develop customer relationships, and contribute to business growth.
Key Responsibilities
 Perform marketing activities and regular market visits. Promote company products and services to potential customers. Generate new leads and follow up with existing clients. Build and maintain good customer relationships. Collect market feedback and submit regular reports. Maintain customer records using computer systems. Eligibility Criteria
 Gender: Both male and female candidates can apply. Experience: Minimum 3 years of marketing or field sales experience. Computer Knowledge: Basic computer skills required. Field Work: Male candidates must be willing to travel and visit customers for field marketing activities. Vehicle: Must have own two-wheeler or four-wheeler. Personal Skills: Good communication, confidence, and customer-handling skills. Salary & Benefits
 Salary: 18,000 20,000 per month. Performance-based incentives. Salary and benefits will be decided based on experience, skills, and performance. 
Full-Time Opportunity | Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra

Key Skills: B2B Marketing,Retail Marketing,Records Management,Good Comm Skills,Field Work,Marketing Strategy,Direct Marketing,Comm
